note: World (WA1) activity spots. Library, interiors, solids and rings: Core-next3 survey kept verbatim. World adds street-prop spots (easels, post boxes, benches, log benches, picnic tables) computed from eden-street-props/placements.ts (front = local +Z) and the house-3 piano. Positions world metres; faceTo a point the body turns to; seatHeight = seat top above the native ground. WN3-0 (World-next3): solids for hedges, stone garden, lookout, pergola/hex-pavilion/market posts, playground and garden props, craft furniture, rocks, vehicles and goals; rings: bandstand gap 90 deg and tea-house gap 180 deg (gap angle = atan2(dz,dx) deg, 45 deg wide, with a step); platforms[] = walkable raised decks (top = deck height above ground, optional step/ramp); greenhouse interior with a west door on the centre aisle. World-owned CN5 data: frisbee lawn clearance; picnic tabletop footprints; library computer; harbour decks; district obstacle survey. Visible pier/mural gaps must be integrated alongside corresponding nav before release.
